brief.subject: A lighthouse at night
brief.intent: A quiet, warm picture: however dark the sea, a light is turning
brief.concept: A wide night scene: the Moon at upper left, the lighthouse on a rock to the right, two beams turning back to back, sweeping the whole sky side on and flaring when they face us; the moonlight and the lamplight each lay a broken path on the sea, the lamp's brightening with the beam; a small boat heading in, and a far light winking on the headland. One line of headline.
brief.direction: Deep blue night against warm lamplight: a sky fading to a warm line on the horizon, stars twinkling each at its own pace, beams of clear warm light, a serif headline
